---
name: New Algorithm Request
about: Propose adding a new cryptographic algorithm, protocol, or scheme
title: "[ALGO] "
labels: ["enhancement", "new-algorithm"]
---

## 💡 Summary
A concise description of the cryptographic algorithm or scheme you want added.

## 🔬 Algorithm Specifications
- **Algorithm Name:** (e.g. Ascon-128a, Curve448, BLAKE3-KDF, Falcon-1024)
- **Target Learning Level:** (e.g. Level 02, Level 04, Level 07)
- **Family / Mathematical Class:** (e.g. Lightweight AEAD, Lattice-based, Isogeny, Sponge)
- **Official Specification / RFC / NIST Standard:** (e.g. NIST SP 800-232, RFC 8032)

## 🎓 Pedagogical Value
Why is this algorithm valuable to include in CipherForge? What concepts does it teach (e.g. constant-time execution, quantum-resistance, low-resource IoT security)?

## 🛠️ Implementation Plan & Test Vectors
- Reference implementation in C/Python or standard RFC test vectors.
- Any external dependencies required (prefer pure Python or standard wheels).
